one_line: Decoding the psychology of money and the hidden rules of wealth — economic paradoxes, financial traps, and the math nobody teaches you.
pillars: Money Paradoxes (the answer that feels right and is wrong)
Psychology of Money (why smart people make bad money decisions)
The Math of Wealth (compounding, exponential growth, real numbers)
When Money Breaks (inflation, currency collapse, trust)
Financial Traps (debt spirals, scams, things designed to cost you)
audience: People who feel confused or anxious about money, young adults navigating first jobs/credit cards/debt, and anyone interested in the financial literacy nobody taught them in school.
tone: Calm, certain, slightly unsettling. Explains the counterintuitive thing plainly, then lets the number do the damage.
